kernel_gap_summary: The kernel candidate record_quick_sale already centralises the sale-spine invariants via the sales-table trigger chain (policy snapshot, config version, commission snapshot, FEFO, loyalty earn, reversal guard). ANY unified writer MUST keep inserting sales rows so on_sale_recorded fires exactly once (single earn/qualify event).

Tender is a separate surface from the accrual spine: record_credit_tender (credit) and record_payment (cash/card/paynow/deposit/no_show_fee) exist but are UI-unwired (finance pilot-disabled). The kernel tender step calls these.

Stored value FOUNDATION now exists (PS-2A / v61): lot-based sv_lots + append-only sv_lot_movements authority with DERIVED balances (no mutable balance column), owner-only mint via sv_topup/sv_grant, and a dedicated sv_authority shipped at 'unbuilt' so nothing is spendable yet. No spend/refund/reserve/expire path (Increments C+) and no cutover. gift_cards remains the legacy single-balance credit instrument (not lot-based); its migration into stored value is explicitly out of PS-2A scope.

writers.authority: HARD-GATED: raises 22023 sv_not_live unless authority='live', and (v64) refuses under an active 'all'/'redeem' sv_pause. 'live' is NO LONGER a merely theoretical state - PS-2 LIVE (v65-v67) builds the path to it and the v69 cutover is what reaches it; the accurate statement as of v67 is that prod authority stays 'unbuilt' for every real business this phase, so the RPC is unreachable in PRODUCTION rather than unreachable in principle. Exercised via a rolled-back authority='live' shim.
writers.kernel: SETTLEMENT-NETTING (v68b) - the v67 §11b refusal is LIFTED and BOTH §10 legs now net. Door B: reversing a checkout settlement restores the exact lots via the shared core and records a public.checkout_sv_tender_reversals marker; sale_balance.sv_tender_totals and get_revenue_summary.v_sv_cash NOT-EXISTS against that marker, so the sale re-opens as A/R and revenue_cash nets down (cash_collected unmoved). A plain non-checkout sv_spend writes no marker and stays reversible. The chargeback interaction is fail-closed in the core (sv_settlement_charged_back) so a later reversal never resurrects clawed-back value.

Cash already refunded before the chargeback is reported SEPARATELY as cash_already_refunded_cents and netted against nothing (contract §3 pinned default, awaiting owner ratification). The immutable v66 sv_topup_payments row is never mutated; the chargeback is append-only evidence beside it.

v263 read-only projection of the customer's own marketing category x channel matrix, resolved through app.customer_communication_identity_v263() from auth.uid(). v271 read-only Programmes Overview aggregate. Returns DISTINCT-CUSTOMER counts per programme (points_ledger earns, loyalty_redemptions, reward_grants, standing birthday redemptions, redeemed welcome offers, qualified referrals, membership enrolments) plus the birthday programme's created_at. Pure SELECTs behind the same owner-or-loyalty-read authorisation business_get_welcome_offer_v215 already uses; no DML, no ledger, no value table, and no customer identity leaves the function - only counts. It exists because a DISTINCT count cannot be expressed through PostgREST, and paging the ledger into the browser to count it there would under-count silently the moment a page limit clipped the result.

V275 read-only customer projection.
